thread:
Sam Chen: FYI customer wants signed order form + countersigned MSA before POC. They require EU entity signer, customer-managed HSM attestation, and net45. Can legal/finance accept a proxy signer for the EU entity? :thinking:

Arun Patel: We can run the POC on Dedicated/Private. BYOK/HSM only supported on Private. What exact attestation wording do they need?

Priya Rao: Sam drop the orderform and redline. Proxy signing will need a delegation/POA and we need a PO for billing validation.

Mei Wong: Also need invoice recipient and VAT. Even if finance agrees to net45, a PO is required before invoicing. If they want consolidated invoices across entities we need legal signoff.

Jordan Kim: Net45 ok with PO + credit check. If procurement is slow, offer prepay/proforma. What SLA are they asking for? Anything above standard needs RevOps approval.

Sam Chen: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/VerticalCloud_Orderform_v2.pdf and VerticalCloud_MSA_redline.docx

Priya Rao: Their redline: "Customer-managed HSM with attestation and key control." Our counter: allow customer-managed HSM for Private only, require independent attestation within 30 days of go-live, otherwise enable Redwood-managed KMS. I'll draft tracked changes.

Emma (security): They flagged data residency, encryption-at-rest, rotation cadence, and key escrow. Our template answers: https://redwood.internal/secure/kb-crypto.

Arun Patel: Signature flow: billing contact signs orderform then exec signs MSA. DocuSign chained envelopes OK. Proposed routing ["billing_contact","legal_counsel","exec_signatory"]. EU proxy supported with delegation docs.

Priya Rao: For proxy we need either notarized POA, board resolution, or an authorized signatory letter plus corporate registry proof. Scanned delegation acceptable in EU with registry match.

Mei Wong: Who's the invoice recipient? Sam confirm.

Sam Chen: Customer says invoices to "VerticalCloud EU Ltd" (VAT EU-VC-9988). Procurement will raise PO in ~10 business days.

Jordan Kim: Finance will accept invoices to that entity but place credit hold until PO. We can issue proforma if they prepay to unblock provisioning.

Priya Rao: Draft KMS counter: "Customer-managed HSM allowed for Private deployments only. Customer must provide independent HSM attestation from an approved assessor within 30 days after go-live. If not provided, Redwood will revert to Redwood-managed KMS. BYOK/export requires prior security exception." Adding as tracked change.

Sam Chen: They also asked for 99.99% SLA with credits.

Jordan Kim: 99.99% is high exposure. We can offer 99.95% for Dedicated with capped credits. 99.99% requires multi-region Dedicated and an SLA uplift fee; Ops/Product must sign off.

Arun Patel: Ops: 4 nines possible only with cross-region redundancy and active failover 5 adds cost. I'll estimate capacity and cost delta.

Priya Rao: Compromise: offer conditional 99.99% if customer commits to 12-month reserved capacity and pays SLA uplift. Limits exposure.

docu_sign_bot: Envelope created for MSA/orderform. Recipients: Priya Rao, Sam Chen, billing_contact. Envelope ID: env_9f8e7d.

Sam Chen: Customer wants countersign by EOD Friday. Legal 5 possible?

Priya Rao: Tight but doable if we finalize KMS/SLA counters quickly. I'll upload tracked changes tomorrow AM and route back to DocuSign.

Mei Wong: After sign, I'll queue provisioning. If they choose prepay, send billing contact and I'll generate proforma.

Sam Chen: Next steps: Priya post counters tomorrow AM; Jordan confirm proforma/credit process; Arun return ops cost for 99.99% multi-region; Sam request delegation docs from customer. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
